title: Searching for Graph
statementMd:
Let's call an undirected graph of $*n*$ vertices *$*p*$-interesting*, if the following conditions fulfill:

- the graph contains exactly $2*n* + *p*$ edges;
- the graph doesn't contain self-loops and multiple edges;
- for any integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$), any subgraph consisting of $*k*$ vertices contains at most $2*k* + *p*$ edges.

A *subgraph* of a graph is some set of the graph vertices and some set of the graph edges. At that, the set of edges must meet the condition: both ends of each edge from the set must belong to the chosen set of vertices.

Your task is to find a *$*p*$-interesting* graph consisting of $*n*$ vertices.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*t*$ ($1 ≤ *t* ≤ 5$) — the number of tests in the input. Next $*t*$ lines each contains two space-separated integers: $*n*$, $*p*$ ($5 ≤ *n* ≤ 24$; $*p* ≥ 0$; ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb77925daa60ed3fa4319d6dab40a46c2e1f67c9.png)) — the number of vertices in the graph and the interest value for the appropriate test.

It is guaranteed that the required graph exists.

## Output

For each of the $*t*$ tests print $2*n* + *p*$ lines containing the description of the edges of a *$*p*$-interesting* graph: the $*i*$-th line must contain two space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$) — two vertices, connected by an edge in the resulting graph. Consider the graph vertices numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$.

Print the answers to the tests in the order the tests occur in the input. If there are multiple solutions, you can print any of them.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

如果一个包含 $*n*$ 个顶点的无向图满足以下条件，我们称其为 *$*p*$-有趣图*：

- 该图恰好包含 $2*n* + *p*$ 条边；
- 该图不包含自环和重边；
- 对于任意整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$），任何包含 $*k*$ 个顶点的子图至多包含 $2*k* + *p*$ 条边。

图的一个子图是由该图的某些顶点和某些边组成的图。其中，边集必须满足以下条件：集合中的每条边的两个端点都属于选定的顶点集。

你的任务是构造一个包含 $*n*$ 个顶点的 *$*p*$-有趣图*。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*t*$（$1 ≤ *t* ≤ 5$），表示输入中的测试用例数量。接下来 $*t*$ 行中的每一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数：$*n*$、$*p*$（$5 ≤ *n* ≤ 24$；$*p* ≥ 0$；![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb77925daa60ed3fa4319d6dab40a46c2e1f67c9.png)），分别表示图的顶点数和对应测试用例中的有趣值。

保证所需的图一定存在。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出 $2*n* + *p*$ 行，描述一个 *$*p*$-有趣图*的边：第 $*i*$ 行必须包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$； $a*_{*i*}$ ≠ $b*_{*i*}$），表示结果图中一条边所连接的两个顶点。规定图中的顶点编号为 $1$ 至 $*n*$。

请按照测试用例在输入中出现的顺序输出答案。如果存在多个解，可以输出其中任意一个。
